Gidansu Ruƙayya yana gefen gari, yana da tsakar gida da murhun yumɓu da dabino guda ɗaya a ciki.

Mahaifiyarta takan gasa burodi a ciki kowace yamma, tana aiki ita kaɗai tun daga la'asar har zuwa faɗuwar rana, kusan ba ta zama.

Ruƙayya 'yar shekara goma sha biyu ce, tana son ɗinkin ado, takan zauna da shi a inda haske yake, kusan ba ta jin waɗanda ke kewaye da ita idan ta riƙe allura.

Wata yamma Ruƙayya ta zauna a bakin ƙofa tana yi wa wata riga ado wadda ta fara tun kwanaki, zaren yana tafiya a hannunta yadda take so.

Sai mahaifiyarta ta kira ta daga tsakar gida: "Ruƙayya, zo ki taimaka mini da kwaɓa fulawa."

Sai ta ce: "Yanzu." Amma ba ta tashi ba. Sannan ta kira ta karo na biyu, sannan na uku, kuma a kowane karo tana cewa: "Yanzu," ba ta ɗauke idonta daga zaren ba.

Sai Ruƙayya ta jefar da rigar daga hannunta, ta tashi tana cewa da babbar murya: "Uf! Kowace rana ni! Babu wani a gidan nan sai ni?"

Sai mahaifiyar ta yi shiru, ba ta mayar mata da kalma ba. Ta kalle ta sau ɗaya kawai, sannan ta koma kan kwaɓinta.

Wannan kallon ya fi kowane zargi nauyi a kan Ruƙayya; da ta yi mata ihu, da ya fi mata sauƙi.

Sai Ruƙayya ta shiga ɗaki ta rufe ƙofa a bayanta, ta zauna tana jiran abin da ke cikin ƙirjinta ya lafa.

Mahaifiyarta kuma ta rage a tsakar gida ita kaɗai: tana kwaɓa, tana hura murhu, tana fitar da burodi, dare kuma yana sauka a kanta.

Gidan ya yi shiru a wannan dare, babu komai a cikinsa sai sautin wuta, da sautin burodi ana ajiye shi a faranti ɗaya bayan ɗaya.

Sannan Bushra, ƙanwarta, ta shigo ta zauna a gefenta ta ce: "Ruƙayya, me ya sa Mama ta yi shiru? Kin yi fushi da ita ne?"

Ruƙayya ba ta sami amsar da za ta ba ta ba. Ta ce: "Ki yi barci, Bushra."

Sai Bushra ta yi barci tana riƙe da gefen rigarta, Ruƙayya kuma ta zauna tana kallon rufin ɗaki, kalmar da ta faɗa tana ta juyawa a kanta.

Sai Ruƙayya ta tuna daren da ta yi rashin lafiya tana ƙarama, lokacin da zazzaɓinta ya hau dare uku ba ta tashi daga shimfiɗarta.

Mahaifiyarta tana zaune a kanta, tana sanya ruwan sanyi a goshinta, tana yi mata addu'a da karatu, ba ta barci har sai ita ta yi barci.

Idan safiya ta yi, sai ta tashi zuwa aikinta kamar ta yi barci isasshe, ba ta faɗa wa kowa cewa ta gaji ba.

Ruƙayya ba ta yi barci ba a wannan dare. Ta yi ta juyi har ta ji mahaifiyarta ta tashi a ƙarshen dare, ta yi alwala sannan ta yi sallah.

Sannan ta ji ta tana addu'a tana sujada, sai ta ji sunanta a cikin addu'arta.

Sai Ruƙayya ta sa hannunta a bakinta don kada a ji muryarta, hawaye suka zubo daga idanunta cikin duhu, ta ce a ranta: Ni ce kuwa na faɗa mata abin da na faɗa.

Da sauran ɗan lokaci kafin alfijir, Ruƙayya ta tashi cikin duhu, ta sa rigarta ta fita zuwa tsakar gida.

Ta kwaɓa sauran fulawa kamar yadda ta ga mahaifiyarta tana kwaɓawa, ta hura murhu, ta gasa burodi har farantin ya cika.

Hannayenta suna rawa saboda sanyi da rashin barci, duk da haka tana murmushi, tana kallon ƙofa yaushe za ta buɗe.

Da mahaifiyar ta fito da alfijir, sai ta sami murhu yana ci, burodi an ajiye shi, Ruƙayya kuma tana tsaye tana jiran ta.

Sai Ruƙayya ta tafi zuwa gare ta, ta kama hannunta ta sumbace shi, sannan ta sumbaci kanta ta ce: "Ki yafe mini, Mama."

Mahaifiyar ba ta ce komai ba, amma ta rungume ta ta daɗe, sannan suka zauna suna gasa burodi tare har rana ta fito.

Tun daga wannan rana, idan ranta ya ɓaci, Ruƙayya takan yi shiru har ɓacin ran ya tafi, sannan ta yi magana.

﴿فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَا أُفٍّ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًا كَرِيمًا﴾

Kuma takan ce wa Bushra: "Kalmar da ta fita daga bakinki ba ta komawa, saboda haka ki duba inda za ki ajiye ta."

📖 Suratul Isra'i, aya ta 23. Wannan labari ne na misali, bai faru da wani mutum na musamman ba.
